args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented as using banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This caused the nightly build to fail, since `tests/test_money.py` asserts half-even behavior (e.g. `2.665` must round to `2.66`).

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` passed.
- Needed for today's release — requests approval and merge.
